statements.status_notes: Fixed upstream in GNU gzip 1.15. Upstream commits 63dbf6b3b9e6e781df1a6a64e609b10e23969681 and e7378c2 (gzip: don't mishandle .lzh after .Z) are in the v1.15 release, whose NEWS records that a buffer overflow when decompressing an .lzh file after a .Z file has been fixed. This package builds the upstream gzip 1.15 release. Source: https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gzip.git/commit/?id=63dbf6b3b9e6e781df1a6a64e609b10e23969681

Fixed upstream in GNU gzip 1.15. Upstream commit 4e6f8b24ab823146ab8776f0b7fe486ab34d4269 (gzexe: use -C if lacking mktemp) is in the v1.15 release, whose NEWS records that gzexe, zdiff and znew no longer have a race when creating a temporary file on platforms lacking mktemp. This package builds the upstream gzip 1.15 release. Source: https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gzip.git/commit/?id=4e6f8b24ab823146ab8776f0b7fe486ab34d4269
